time_series_query.time_series_query_language:
fetch gce_instance
| metric 'custom.googleapis.com/dummy'
| group_by 15m, [value_dummy_mean: mean(value.dummy)]
| every 1m
| group_by
    [metric.quark_pools, metric.quark_region, metric.quark_clusters,
     metric.quark_volumes],
    [value_dummy_mean_max: max(value_dummy_mean)]
| value
    [value_dummy_mean_max_cast_units: cast_units(value_dummy_mean_max, 'By')]
| map
    add[Region: metric.quark_region, Clusters: metric.quark_clusters,
      Pools: metric.quark_pools, Volumes: metric.quark_volumes]

fetch gce_instance
| metric 'custom.googleapis.com/dummy'
| group_by 15m, [value_dummy_mean: mean(value.dummy)]
| every 15m
| group_by
    [metric.quark_pools, metric.quark_region, metric.quark_clusters,
     metric.quark_volumes],
    [value_dummy_mean_max: max(value_dummy_mean)]
| value
    [value_dummy_mean_max_cast_units: cast_units(value_dummy_mean_max, 'By')]

fetch k8s_container
| metric 'custom.googleapis.com/ntapvol_logical_size_available'
| group_by 5m,
    [value_ntapvol_logical_size_available_mean:
       mean(value.ntapvol_logical_size_available)]
| every 5m
| group_by [resource.location],
    [value_ntapvol_logical_size_available_mean_aggregate:
       aggregate(value_ntapvol_logical_size_available_mean)]
| value
    [value_ntapvol_logical_size_available_mean_aggregate_cast_units:
       cast_units(value_ntapvol_logical_size_available_mean_aggregate, 'By')]

fetch k8s_container
| metric 'custom.googleapis.com/ntapvol_logical_size_used'
| group_by 1m,
    [value_ntapvol_logical_size_used_mean:
       mean(value.ntapvol_logical_size_used)]
| every 1m
| group_by [resource.location],
    [value_ntapvol_logical_size_used_mean_aggregate:
       aggregate(value_ntapvol_logical_size_used_mean)]
| value
    [value_ntapvol_logical_size_used_mean_aggregate_cast_units:
       cast_units(value_ntapvol_logical_size_used_mean_aggregate, 'By')]
